mentions.name: PaperCove
mentions.description: A minimalist web reader used daily to follow RSS feeds, newsletters, and read-later articles, helping keep content from piling up. Features content extraction and email-based newsletter ingestion. Built with Laravel and Livewire, Python for extraction, and Go for email infrastructure; a beta release is planned this month.
mentions.problem: Keeping up with RSS feeds, newsletters, and saved articles is hard, and things pile up.
mentions.audience: Readers who want to follow RSS feeds, newsletters and read-later articles without content piling up; the author uses it every day and is opening a beta to gather feedback.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working since the start of the year on a minimalist web reader (https://papercove.app) that I use every day to follow RSS feeds, newsletters and read-later, and that helps keep things from piling up.
mentions.author: dummoria
